entities.summary: Trisha Shetty is an Indian activist for gender equality and the founder of SheSays. She is known for human rights advocacy, especially advocating for gender-sensitive policies and law, quality education, youth and gender representation and preventing sexual violence in India. Her work and advocacy has been recognised by the United Nations, President Obama, Queen Elizabeth II and President Emmanuel Macron. She currently serves as the President of the Steering Committee of the Paris Peace Forum, an international summit launched in 2018, under the leadership of President Macron; to promote good global governance.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Trisha Shetty's work on gender equality and human rights has had a significant regional impact in South Asia, particularly in India. Her advocacy has led to policy changes and increased representation of women in various sectors.
